subject: Lead Sentinel: Renewal Signals & Exec Escalation Digest
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren_Board <board@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lead Sentinel: Renewal Signals & Exec Escalation Digest

Team —

Putting together a compact digest ahead of QBR prep: this thread consolidates the top renewal signals from the last 30 days and surfaces two items that need exec visibility before we finalize QBR decks. I attached the working renewal risk register and the slide pack for review.

High level:
- Focus set: five customers with elevated renewal risk (score >= 7/10). See register.
- Immediate exec attention: Aurora Systems (pricing + latency concerns) and Borealis Cloud (security questionnaire backlog + SOC documentation).

Asks:
1) Please review the attached register and the draft slide notes — add any one-sentence notes inline by EOD 4/27.
2) Laura / Rishi: prioritize which signals we want on the exec slide (I recommend only Aurora + Borealis).
3) Mina: please validate the remediation ETA column today and update the register.

I will compile final asks and an action table for the QBR on 5/10.

Attachments: renewal_risk_register_v1.xlsx; Lead_Sentinel_QBR_Slides_2028-05.pptx

Thanks —
Irene Choi
VP, Customer Strategy 
Redwood Inference

Irene —

Thanks for the digest. Quick notes inline:

- Prioritization: agree Aurora and Borealis for exec slides. Can we surface a short "why now" line for each (one sentence)?
- OKR tie: let's add a short callout linking remediation to FY28 Q3 OKR "Platform Stability - SLOs" so execs see impact.

Also: small ask — can we collapse the register's signal-source column into a single footnote to keep slides tight?

Subject: Lead Sentinel: Final asks for Exec slide + QBR action table (5/10)

Team —

Thanks for the rapid updates. Finalized asks going into the QBR (action items below). Please treat these as prep for the 5/12 exec sync.

Exec slide (top two items):
- Aurora Systems (Owner: Rishi) — Key ask: commit to a 48-hour remediation SLA for visible performance regressions; provide revenue exposure estimate and proposed discount bands.
- Borealis Cloud (Owner: Mina) — Key ask: deliver SOC evidence and a remediation timeline; confirm gating criteria for renewal conversation.

Action table (owners & deadlines):
- Rishi: revenue exposure estimate + SOW draft (due 2028-05-12)
- Mina: SOC evidence status + updated register (due 2028-05-17)
- Laura: final exec slide copy and one-line "why now" for each account (due 2028-05-11)
- Karthik: confirm engineering capacity to test Aurora latency fixes (due 2028-05-13)

Links: HubSpot deal RDW-1927 (https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/1927), QBR pack in Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR_Pack_Aurora)

I will present these slides at the 5/12 exec sync unless you flag any reason not to.

Thanks —

VP, Customer Strategy
